description: an http.Agent with a finite maxSockets (1, 2; keepAlive on and off) on loopback hands each freed slot to the next queued request: sequential and parallel GETs all answered, each request's 'close' emitted, a POST body included (0.23.0 to 0.26.0 hung from the first queued request on); and the events' order: req 'finish', res 'end', res 'close', req 'close' (destroyed); a refused connect's 'error' then 'close'
